title: Q-learning Penalized Transformer for Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.34426v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper addresses the problem of safe offline reinforcement learning, which involves training a policy to satisfy safety constraints using an offline dataset. This problem is inherently challenging as it requires balancing three highly interconnected and competing objectives: satisfying safety constraints, maximizing rewards, and adhering to the behavior regularization imposed by the offline dataset. To tackle this trilogy challenge, we propose Q-learning Penalized Transformer policy (QPT), a \emph{training--inference consistent} framework that bridges conditional sequence modeling with constraint-aware value estimation. QPT trains a Transformer policy that generates actions conditioned on trajectory context and target return/cost, retaining strong behavior regularization. translated_title: 面向安全离线强化学习的Q学习惩罚Transformer策略
translated_abstract: 本文研究安全离线强化学习问题，即利用离线数据集训练一个满足安全约束的策略。该问题本质上极具挑战性，因为它需要平衡三个高度关联且相互竞争的目标：满足安全约束、最大化奖励，以及遵循离线数据集所施加的行为正则化。为应对这一“三重挑战”，我们提出了Q学习惩罚Transformer策略（QPT），这是一个训练—推理一致的框架，将条件序列建模与约束感知的价值估计相连接。QPT训练一个Transformer策略，该策略以轨迹上下文和目标回报/代价为条件生成动作，从而保持较强的行为正则化。为了在学习过程中注入显式的安全语义，我们利用学习到的奖励Q函数和代价Q函数构造Q形惩罚项来增强序列模型的训练，以（此处摘要原文截断）
tldr: 提出训练—推理一致的Q学习惩罚Transformer策略（QPT），将条件序列建模与约束感知的价值估计相结合，并借助学习到的奖励与代价Q函数构造Q形惩罚注入显式安全语义，从而在离线数据下平衡安全约束、奖励最大化与行为正则化这三重相互竞争的目标。
en_tdlr: Proposes Q-learning Penalized Transformer (QPT), a training-inference consistent framework that bridges conditional sequence modeling with constraint-aware value estimation, injecting explicit safety semantics through a Q-shaped penalty built from learned reward and cost Q-functions to balance safety constraints, reward maximization, and behavior regularization in safe offline reinforcement learning.
